## Blood Orc (CR 1/3)

**XP** 135  
 Blood orc warrior 1  
 CE Medium humanoid (orc)  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception -2  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +1 Dex)  
 **hp** 8 (1d10+2 plus 1)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +2, **Will** -2  
 **Defensive Abilities** ferocity  
 **Weaknesses** light sensitivity  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** greataxe +6 (1d12+6/x3), bite +0 (1d4+2)  
 **Ranged** javelin +2 (1d6+4)  
 **Special Attacks** frenzy  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 18, **Dex** 13, **Con** 14, **Int** 8, **Wis** 6, **Cha** 6  
 **Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 16  
 **Feats** [Weapon Focus (greataxe)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (greataxe).*  
 **Skills** Intimidate +2  
 **Languages** Common, Orc  
 **Gear** chain shirt, greataxe, 3 javelins  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Frenzy (Ex)** Once per day a blood orc who smells or tastes blood during combat may fly into a frenzy in the following round, biting and attacking with its weapons until it or its opponent is dead. It gains +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and -2 AC. The creature cannot end its frenzy voluntarily.  
 


**Ecology**

 
**Environment** temperate hills  
 **Organization** gang (2-4), squad (11-20 plus 2 3rd-level sergeants and 1 leader of 3rd-6th level), band (30-300 plus 150% noncombatant plus 1 3rd-level sergeant per 10 adults, 5 5th-level lieutenants, and 3 7th-level captains) or tribe (1d4 bands plus 1 10th-12th level chieftain)  
 **Treasure** standard
